title: Manipulation Sidecar Schema
description: Metadata sidecar for a manipulated (edited/generatively-inpainted) media artifact. Traceability is HYBRID: a live parent link (parent.uuid) for fast in-repo traversal, plus a self-contained provenance_chain that each manipulation inherits from its parent and extends with the parent's own entry. The chain records each ancestor's uuid, operation, generator (prompt/seed/model), mask GEOMETRY (bbox/quad — survives loss of the mask PNG) and sha256, so the full lineage is recoverable from this artifact ALONE even when ancestor files/sidecars are unavailable. Supports manipulation-over-manipulation via manipulation_depth and root_uuid.

uuid.description: Unique identifier (UUID v4) for this manipulated artifact

source.description: Pristine root attribution, inherited down the whole manipulation chain

parent.description: Live link to the IMMEDIATE input of this operation. Null for externally-sourced manipulations whose history is unknown.

uuid.description: UUID of the immediate parent artifact

type.description: Artifact type of the parent (so a traversal knows which schema to load)

original_path.description: Path to the immediate input image (convenience; provenance integrity relies on parent.uuid, not this path)

root_uuid.description: UUID of the pristine root artifact at the base of the chain (denormalized shortcut so 'all manipulations derived from X' needs no full walk). Null when the origin is unknown (external).

manipulation_depth.description: Number of manipulation hops from a pristine image (0 = first manipulation on a real image, 1 = manipulation of a manipulation, ...)

provenance.description: Origin marker for artifacts without a resolvable in-repo parent

manipulation_type.description: Operation applied to produce this artifact ('unknown' for externally-sourced manipulations whose method is not known)

mask.description: Region this operation edited. Stores BOTH a reference (file/uuid) AND geometry (bbox/quad) so 'which region was edited' survives loss of the mask PNG.

file.description: Path/filename of the mask PNG (255 inside, 0 outside)

uuid.description: UUID of the mask artifact, when it is a tracked artifact

bbox.description: Upright box of the edited region [x, y, width, height] in pixels

quad.description: Four corner points [[x,y], ...] of the edited quadrilateral in pixels

source_image_size.description: Pixel size of the immediate input image

output_size.description: Pixel size of this manipulated output

generator.description: The AI system that produced this manipulation (EU AI Act Annex IV) plus the parameters needed to reproduce it

fake_region.description: Where the fake region is defined ('mask' = this op's mask; 'cumulative' = union of all masks up the chain)

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the manipulated output file (fixity)

provenance_chain.description: Self-contained, append-only lineage: each ancestor's compact record, oldest (root) first. Copied from the parent and extended with the parent's own entry, so this artifact is fully traceable standalone.

manipulated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this manipulation was produced
